subject: Fix memory leak in the new hashtable unittest (#1421)
reason: The change is a one-line fix in src/unit/test_hashtable.c, adding free(e) to plug a memory leak in the hashtable unit test's own test code. It modifies only the unittest binary, not the server: no command, reply, replication, cluster, persistence or tool behaviour changes, so no fuzzer scenario can reach or exercise it.
